subject: Re: one more slot
body:
Hi Aria,

Thanks for the follow-up. Unfortunately I'm not available at 9:00 am on Monday as I don't take meetings before 11:00 am. Could we look at a later slot? Here are a few options that work for me:

- Tuesday, Sep 15 at 11:30 am
- Wednesday, Sep 16 at 2:00 pm
- Thursday, Sep 17 at 1:00 pm

Please let me know if any of these suit you and your partner, and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Sam
